site.title: PS5 Homebrew Compendium
site.tagline: A curated, community directory of PlayStation 5 homebrew — emulators, jailbreaks, tools and apps.
site.description: MOCKUP — simulated prototype data. Versions, dates, authors and firmware ranges are illustrative and unverified. Do not use for real guidance. Item 'icon' values are URLs (developer avatars used as stand-ins) or named words.
site.disclaimer: Mockup prototype. A project by ALONSOJR1980 (https://github.com/alonsojr1980). For lawful homebrew on a console you own or are authorized to modify only. This concept links to official/open-source project pages and does not host ROMs, BIOS files, keys, game dumps, or copyrighted packages. Modifying a console may void warranties, risk account restrictions, or brick the device. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Sony Interactive Entertainment. items.name: PS5 RetroArch
items.summary: Multi-system libretro frontend with RADV Vulkan rendering and a local WebUI.
items.description: A port of RetroArch to PS5 exposing many libretro cores (Dolphin, LRPS2, PPSSPP, Mupen64Plus-Next, Snes9x, mGBA, Genesis Plus GX and more). Offers an XMB or EmulationStation front screen and a local WebUI for content upload and core settings.
items.author: mihawk-99

firmware.notes: Depends on an exploit chain and a HEN stack.

warnings: Requires your own BIOS/keys for some cores.

items.name: ProsperoEden
items.summary: Unofficial PS5 port of the Eden Nintendo Switch emulator with Vulkan rendering.
items.description: Runs Nintendo Switch software on PS5 via the Eden emulator tree, rendering through RADV Vulkan. Supports internal resolution scaling up to 4x and multiple controllers. Requires the user to supply their own keys, firmware, and game files.
items.author: blackbearreloaded
warnings: Does not include keys or firmware — supply your own lawful dumps.

items.name: PS5SX2
items.summary: PCSX2 port with a cover-flow shelf, upscaling, RetroAchievements and patches.
items.description: A PlayStation 2 emulator built as a native PS5 app. Games load as ISO, CHD, CSO or ZSO from a shelf and can be upscaled with 4K output and FSR. Supports HD texture packs, widescreen/60 FPS patches and the emulated network adapter. Requires your own PS2 BIOS.
items.author: Swordpdf

firmware.notes: Tester reports across a wide firmware range.

warnings: A helper payload jailbreaks the title at launch.

items.name: PS5X360
items.summary: Experimental Xbox 360 emulator built on Xenia Canary with RADV Vulkan.
items.description: An experimental Xbox 360 emulator for PS5 using Xenia Canary, with DualSense input, native audio and RADV Vulkan. Pulls box art from XboxUnity and supports community Canary patches. Booting a menu is not the same as finishing a level — crashes are expected.
items.author: BrinooTk
warnings: Highly experimental — crashes and visual errors expected.

items.name: Porpoise
items.summary: Dedicated GameCube and Wii emulator front end for Dolphin on PS5.
items.description: A native Dolphin front end for PS5 with a cover-flow library, box art, memory cards and original menu music. Uses the libretro Dolphin core and a PS5 Vulkan/RADV driver. RetroAchievements are surfaced through the ELF loader.
items.author: elripalda
warnings: Requires the HEN to leave the app sandbox at launch.

items.name: PS5CEMU-HAR
items.summary: Two Nintendo generations in one app: Cemu for Wii U and Azahar for 3DS.
items.description: Combines Cemu (Wii U) and Azahar (3DS) under one homebrew title. Wii U games run at up to 2160p with graphic packs and GamePad touch on the DualSense touchpad; the 3DS side emulates a New 3DS with save states, cheats and network play.
items.author: premohq
warnings: Cemu and Azahar never run at the same time.
Amiibo dumps must be supplied by the user.

items.name: XPSemu
items.summary: Original Xbox (2001) emulator via xemu, with RADV Vulkan and cover flow.
items.description: xemu built as a native PS5 app on the RADV Vulkan driver, running the Xbox CPU through a QEMU JIT and the NV2A GPU through xemu's Vulkan renderer. Includes an Xbox-style cover flow with per-game settings and in-memory patches.
items.author: ZiZc3
warnings: A separate tools ELF handles the app jailbreak.

items.name: Snes9x PS5
items.summary: A dedicated Super Nintendo app with a 3D cover-flow shelf and multitap support.
items.description: A native port of Snes9x 1.63 as a standalone app with automatic covers, battery saves, save states, cheat files and IPS/UPS/BPS patches. Supports up to four DualSense pads for multitap games. No netplay or rewind.
items.author: MisterTemaki

items.name: Relapse
items.summary: Browser + kernel exploit chain for PS5 firmware 7.00–13.60, ending in an ELF loader.
items.description: A public exploit chain combining a WebKit entry point with a kernel bug to obtain kernel read/write and start an ELF loader on port 9021. Firmware 14.00 and above are outside the supported window. The exploit is temporary and must be re-run after a full reboot.
items.author: ntfargo and contributors

firmware.notes: Only specific builds are supported; check the project's live list.

warnings: Can hang or kernel-panic the console; may need several attempts.
A newer system update can close the entry point.

items.name: WebKit Autoloader
items.summary: Host-driven setup that auto-detects firmware and routes to a documented exploit path.
items.description: A host program that guides the exploit setup for supported firmware, routing to the appropriate chain and a payload manager. Maintains a live firmware compatibility list and special routing for certain builds.
items.author: itsPLK

firmware.notes: Routing differs per firmware band; some builds use alternative entry points.

warnings: Verify your exact firmware build against the project's live list before proceeding.

items.name: etaHEN
items.summary: All-in-one homebrew enabler payload and toolbox for jailbroken PS5 consoles.
items.description: The homebrew enabler that prepares the system and provides a toolbox for running payloads, mounting homebrew and managing content. Typically paired with kstuff and a game mounter.
items.author: Gezine / LightningMods
warnings: Does not include a kernel exploit; an entry point is still required.

items.name: kstuff
items.summary: Kernel patching payload that enables homebrew SELF/PKG loading.
items.description: Dynamically patches the PS5 kernel to bypass security checks so homebrew packages can run. Often used together with an application jailbreak for emulators and homebrew titles.
items.author: EchoStretch and contributors

items.name: ShadowMountPlus
items.summary: Automated background auto-mounter payload for jailbroken PS5 consoles.
items.description: A background service that scans storage and mounts homebrew and game content automatically, exposing them to the system. Used by most emulators as the content source.
items.author: Drakmor

items.name: OnionHEN
items.summary: Modular all-in-one HEN and toolbox with FTP, game mounting, cheats and an overlay.
items.description: A payload stack that prepares the system, injects a ShellUI toolbox, and runs overlays, cheats, payloads and background services. Includes an embedded FTP server, game scanner/mounter, Remote Play pairing and an in-game performance overlay.
items.author: ps3120

firmware.notes: Requires an external elfldr on port 9021 for the first hop.

warnings: Does not include a kernel exploit; you still need an entry point.

items.name: zftpd
items.summary: Zero-copy FTP/HTTP server payload for fast transfers to and from the console.
items.description: A lightweight server payload for moving files to and from a jailbroken PS5 over FTP or HTTP, designed for speed.
items.author: community

items.name: PKG Manager
items.summary: Browse and install PKGs from USB, disc or SMB shares on the console.
items.description: A utility to browse and install package files from USB storage, a disc, or an SMB share directly on a jailbroken PS5.
items.author: community
warnings: Only install content you are legally entitled to use.

items.name: JT Play
items.summary: Media player that browses storage, plays video and audio, and visualizes music.
items.description: A homebrew media player for PS5 that browses storage, plays video and audio files, and includes a visualizer for music playback.
items.author: John Torl

items.name: BF Player
items.summary: Single-payload media player with subtitles, audio tracks and seeking.
items.description: Installs from a single payload into the media section. Supports seeking, subtitles, audio track selection, volume and aspect-ratio changes from the touchpad and options menus.
items.author: John Torl

items.name: PS5 Web File Manager
items.summary: File manager with a browser-based UI for moving and organizing files.
items.description: A file manager for PS5 that exposes a web UI, letting you browse, move and organize files from a phone or computer on the same network.
items.author: community
